About us · Our story

Built on quality, trusted for over 10 years

Creative Building Solution started in Daltonganj as a small team of civil engineers and site craftsmen with one rule: build every structure as if our own family would use it.

Over the last decade we have completed more than 100 projects, from homes and commercial buildings to roads and public works. As we grew, we set up two group companies so every client gets a focused team.

Modern Craft Homes supplies building materials, sanitary ware, marble, tiles and paints. Shivay Construction carries out government projects such as roads and community buildings.

Services

What we do

Civil, public, residential and commercial construction, plus repair and renovation.

Civil construction

Roads, culverts, drains, boundary walls, earthwork and site development.

Residential homes

Independent houses and duplexes, from foundation to finishing.

Public infrastructure

Community buildings, schools and street beautification work.

Commercial buildings

Shops, offices, showrooms and warehouses, built to schedule.

RCC & structural work

Columns, beams, slabs and structural strengthening.

Renovation & repair

Extensions, remodelling, crack repair, waterproofing and re-plastering.

Electrical & plumbing

Wiring, panels, lighting, water supply, drainage and sanitary fitting.
